items.title: Special cancellation right due to price increase
items.quote: Damit die Kündigung wirkt, muss sie bei uns vor dem Inkrafttreten der neuen Preise eingehen.
items.computation: The letter is dated 20.11.2026 and announces a price increase effective 01.01.2027. The letter grants an unconditional special right of termination effective 01.01.2027, but states the cancellation must reach the provider before the new prices take effect, i.e. before 01.01.2027. The last day the cancellation can still arrive is therefore the day before, 31.12.2026 (a Thursday; 31 December is not a public holiday in NRW, so no weekend/holiday shift applies).
